13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. 13.1 grants the subscription access right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), with no "non-transferable", "revocable" or narrow internal-use-only limitation. 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, including contractor support, and 14.3 confirms it covers Vendor Technology needed to use Deliverables. 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under an assignment permitted by Section 24 (24.1 allows consent-free assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. "Affiliate" is defined on standard control terms with no carve-outs, so no licence-scope redline is required.
